SQL 125 needs public.deposit_queue_scored, public.deposit_owner_performance, public.deposit_reminder_queue and public.deposit_aging_dashboard (the restored Supabase-era views; spec prerequisites), each a view owned by the applying login (altered_relations_owned_by_login; the file raises sql125_not_view_owner otherwise), with the definitions the spec pins (the supabase migrations' views as PostgreSQL renders them; the fingerprint carries each definition's sha256, so a production view that differs from the reviewed one fails the intended state and the apply rolls back). No API or SPA change: the views stay on the read allowlist and checksops keeps SELECT on them. Adds no trigger and no function: the DB validator is not affected.
